name: materials
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source material sheet for a 2D Gothic game called Poison Moss Land. BOTTOM RIGHT: darker supporting columns/ceiling masonry, regular large emerald stone blocks with ivy veins and subdued moss, black-green cracks, fully solid front-on texture.
